derived_checks.interpretation: XRP-market 12.67-12.68% bonus matches 62.5% LLTV; generic 4.38% corresponds to 86% LLTV.

confirmed_primary_facts: Coinbase lists XRP as eligible collateral for USDC loans powered by Morpho on Base.
Coinbase maps XRP collateral to cbXRP on Base at the contract recorded above.
Coinbase states collateral is locked on Morpho and marked not tradeable while active; locked collateral remains in displayed total balance while debt is not netted.
Morpho identifies the full market ID, 62.5% LLTV and Chainlink oracle/feed metadata in its first-party app.
Morpho docs state LLTV is immutable per market and liquidation occurs when LTV reaches or exceeds LLTV.
provider_observations: MorphoWatch reports $62.94M supplied, $55.52M borrowed, 88.2% utilization, $7.42M available and 120.45M cbXRP collateral at 13:21 UTC.
MorphoWatch reports 1,479 liquidations and $6.27M debt repaid over 30 days.
MorphoWatch models $26.81M collateral at risk under a 20% cbXRP decline; this is not expected loss.
Morpho app reports 0.00 USDC realized/unrealized bad debt at retrieval; this is UI data, not independently decoded contract state.
inference_not_fact: Collateralized borrowing may reduce immediate XRP sale needs for some holders.
A sharp decline can trigger liquidation and transfer collateral to liquidators who may later sell it.
High utilization and vault concentration create market/curator dependencies, but do not prove system-wide XRP liquidity stress.
non_equivalences: Outstanding USDC debt is not proof of XRP purchases or net capital entering XRP.
Base cbXRP collateral is not native XRPL lending.
Locked cbXRP is not freely tradeable inventory.
Liquidation count/debt repaid are not XRP sold.
Modeled collateral at risk is not realized loss.
The $219.01M oracle value-secured label is not assumed to be this market's collateral.

The product adds collateral utility without necessarily adding XRP demand.
